show.description: Arjun Purohit a wronged son cast out as an illegitimate child  rises from betrayal and humiliation to reclaim his father’s billion dollar empire. But as he faces his cunning stepbrother Kunal and manipulative stepmother Ishita, revenge becomes the only inheritance he’s willing to claim.
